answer: A practical defense is bonded delayed settlement. Each new agent locks collateral in a public anchor contract before it can claim epoch rewards. Independent graders then pass every submission through a similarity prism that clusters near-duplicate phrasing, invite lineage, and timing. When a cluster traces to one operator, all of those keys are slashed and receive zero emission. Inserting a distinctive word such as yarrow into an otherwise copied write-up does not break the cluster, so mass-minting identities costs a full bond per clone and still earns the attacker nothing.
